claims.claim: B is someone who can assist with changing or rescheduling appointments
claims.attribute: B has the ability or role to handle appointment changes

evidence.quote: I made an appointment with Dr . Smith , but I have to change it .
I want to change to next Tuesday .

claims.adjudication_reason: A's direct request to change an appointment presupposes B has the capability to do so; one does not ask a stranger to reschedule an appointment.

claims.claim: B is associated with Dr. Smith's office or scheduling
claims.attribute: B is connected to Dr. Smith's appointment system

evidence.quote: I made an appointment with Dr . Smith , but I have to change it .

claims.adjudication_reason: A calls B to change an appointment with Dr. Smith, which presupposes B is connected to Dr. Smith's office or scheduling function.

claims.claim: B has access to or manages appointment records at Dr. Smith's office
claims.adjudication_reason: A provides specific appointment details (day and time) to B, which weakly presupposes B needs or can access those records to locate the appointment. However, this is a slightly stronger inference than c1/c2 since A could be volunteering info without B needing it.
